# Objective

Configure the existing private remote `jiangyun-fun/seqconsistency` with
production defaults, cut release v0.1.0, and deliver a public-readiness check.
Making the repo public is NOT requested — the check reports blockers for a
later flip.

# Scope

1. Local hygiene: MIT LICENSE file (README already declares MIT; none exists),
   pyproject metadata fix (Homepage points at the wrong owner
   `jiangyunacw`), dev extra gains the stub packages mypy needs
   (`types-PyYAML`, `scipy-stubs`), README badges, remove the stray
   `utput-format=concise` file.
2. CI: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — one job named `ci`, ubuntu-latest,
   Python 3.12, `pip install .[dev]`, ruff + mypy + full pytest (incl. slow).
   Action majors resolved at write time: `actions/checkout@v7`,
   `actions/setup-python@v7` (latest releases 2026-10-26).
3. Release: `.github/workflows/release.yml` — tag `v*.*.*` or manual dispatch,
   `python -m build` (sdist+wheel), attach to the GitHub release via `gh`.
4. Dependabot: `pip` + `github-actions`, weekly, grouped.
5. Repo settings via `gh api -X PATCH` (squash-only, delete-branch-on-merge,
   projects off), non-locking branch protection on `main` (context `ci`),
   topics (bioinformatics, sequencing-qc, fastq, bam, python).
6. Release v0.1.0: annotated tag, push, release workflow builds and attaches,
   assets verified (`gh release view`).
7. Public-readiness report: blockers and near-blockers found during the work.

# Files to touch

Created: `LICENSE`, `.github/workflows/{ci,release}.yml`,
`.github/dependabot.yml`, this plan + report.
Updated: `pyproject.toml`, `README.md`, `docs/misc/*`.
Removed: `utput-format=concise` (trash).

# Risks

1. CI installs latest ruff/mypy — rule drift vs local pins could fail the run;
   mitigation: watch the first run and pin if it drifts.
2. Full pytest on a 2-core runner: slow memory tests allocate ~1 GiB; within
   runner limits; fallback `-m 'not slow'` if timeouts.
3. Branch protection before CI ever ran can strand the context — protection is
   applied after the first green run.
4. The 8 unpushed local commits land on the remote with this push — intended.

# Verification (results)

Executed 2026-10-26; report: `20261026-122944_github-setup.report.qmd`.

1. First CI run FAILED (pandas missing from the dev extra; duckdb removed
   `Relation.fetchone()`) — both fixed; second run green (run 40268806314).
2. Branch protection NOT applied: the API returns 403 on private repos under
   a free plan ("Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public").
   Deferred to the public flip; the intended ruleset stays recorded here.
3. Release `v0.1.0` verified: wheel (88,590 bytes) + sdist (136,174 bytes)
   attached; sdist contents checked (46 files, no internal paths, no pixi.toml).
4. Readiness verdict: not ready to flip today — internal pixi channel URLs,
   deferred branch protection, benchmark hostname; secrets scan clean
   (working tree + `git log -S'ghp_'` pickaxe).
5. Settings verified via fresh GET (squash-only, delete-branch-on-merge,
   wiki/projects off); six topics applied.

# Original verification plan (superseded above)

1. `gh run list` shows the CI run green on the pushed head.
2. `gh api .../branches/main/protection` returns the applied ruleset.
3. `gh release view v0.1.0` lists sdist + wheel assets.
4. Readiness report enumerates blockers with severity and exact fixes.
